source_checks.finding: Apple iCloud backup article (the regional mirror of support.apple.com/en-us/108366, returned by search). Introduction supports the excerpt verbatim: "You can back up your device manually, and/or turn on iCloud Backup to automatically keep your device backed up." Section "Automatically back up with iCloud Backup" supports the steps: open Settings and tap your name; tap iCloud, then iCloud Backup, and make sure Back Up This [Device] is on. Conditions on the page: connect to a power source, connect to a Wi-Fi network, keep the screen locked, and buy more storage if the not-enough-storage alert appears. Page is for iPhone, which matches this user.

Google article on backing up Android devices. Introduction supports "You can back up content, data, and settings from your phone to your Google Account." The page is for Android, so it does not apply to this user, who has an iPhone. It is a correctly unused distractor.

required_actions.action: Open the Settings app and tap your name
Tap iCloud, then tap iCloud Backup
Make sure Back Up This iPhone is turned on
For automatic backup, connect to a power source and a Wi-Fi network, and keep the screen locked
If an alert says there is not enough iCloud storage, follow the onscreen steps to buy more storage
